description.value:
Frequency once per hour

Read the Ground becomes a free action once per hour; further uses in that hour cost their usual action. When you Read the Ground this way, you also learn the last creature to have crossed the area — what kind of thing it was, roughly how long ago, and which way it went. You do not learn its name, its condition, or anything it was carrying.

cinderfall.incomplete: No rule element retargets a *different* card's action cost conditionally and periodically (`CF-list` — `ItemAlteration` has no action-cost field even for permanent alteration, let alone a frequency-gated one). Bucket 3/5 combination: a frequency-limited conversion of another item's action economy, real content, no mechanism.
